title: Fintech Credit-Scoring Seminar
summary: A reproducible pipeline that builds six synthetic credit-risk datasets (rule-based, copula, and CTGAN-based) for scorable and unscorable borrowers, then trains and benchmarks logistic-regression and random-forest credit-scoring models. The CTGAN library is imported directly in the synthetic-data-generation scripts and run to produce one of the synthetic dataset variants.
